script: Pufferfish puff up by gulping water until they are a ball much bigger than normal. Many pufferfish carry a poison called tetrodotoxin. It is far more poisonous than cyanide. In Japan, chefs need a special license to serve pufferfish, called fugu. One kind of male pufferfish sculpts beautiful circular patterns in the sand. Scientists think these sand circles help attract a mate. Follow Pixel Abyss for more strange facts from the deep.
